title: Contract oracle and traffic-snapshot CI gate for SDKs (Python/TS/Go)
creator: Aisha Karim
description: Build a cross-language contract oracle and traffic-snapshot system that captures representative SDK traffic from CI and dev environments, normalizes noisy fields, stores versioned "golden" snapshots, and provides a CI gating job that asserts behavioral regressions for Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. The system should handle streaming responses and partial bodies, support token-level diffs with configurable fuzz thresholds, and include a local dev proxy for iterative recording and inspection.
acceptance_criteria: CI job 'sdk-contract-oracle' runs for Python/TS/Go unit and e2e suites and fails on regressions beyond configured thresholds
Traffic snapshot format defined (snap.v1) with schema and normalization rules checked into repo
Local developer proxy can record live calls to Redwood API and emit a versioned snapshot that passes normalization
Streaming responses (chunked/partial) are captured and replayed deterministically under the oracle with replay rate limiting
Diffing supports token-level alignment and a fallback fuzzy matcher; thresholds are configurable per-test
Documentation and examples added for all three SDKs showing how to record, update golden snapshots, and interpret diffs
implementation_notes: Architecture: 1) recorder (local proxy/CI hook), 2) normalizer (schema driven), 3) snapshot store (S3-backed with metadata), 4) oracle (comparator with fuzzy/token diffs), 5) CI runner integration
Normalization rules should remove/timebox request IDs, timestamps, hostnames, ephemeral tokens, and map floating-point score fields to rounded buckets
Streaming capture: buffer chunk boundaries and include sequence indices; oracle replays by applying the same chunk sizes but allows throttled timing to simulate latency
Token-level diff: use byte-level tokenizer output from SDK tokenizer helpers where available; otherwise fall back to string tokenization with whitespace + punctuation rules
Provide SDK helpers: record_snapshot(), assert_snapshot_match() for Python/TS/Go. Helpers must accept a 'relaxation' parameter to allow intentional drift during model changes
Store snapshots alongside test fixtures using a naming convention: <sdk>/<suite>/<snapshot_name>@<snap_version>.snap.v1
progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with SDK leads; agreed scope includes streaming support and crosslang helpers
2026-02-22: Prototype recorder implemented as a local HTTP proxy (Go) that logs requests/responses including chunk metadata; initial serializer produced
2026-02-27: Normalization schema draft uploaded to design doc; reviewed by Security for PII handling
2026-03-03: Token-diff prototype using Python tokenizer helper shows better signal than raw string diffs for streaming chat responses
2026-03-08: CI job skeleton merged for TypeScript SDK; failing fast on format mismatches allowed to avoid blocking other pipelines
2026-03-10: Added configurable fuzz matcher and per-suite thresholds; PRs created for Python and Go helper APIs
blockers: Need final decision on snapshot retention/GC policy from infra (cost concerns for long-lived golden snapshots)
Tokenization parity: TypeScript SDK uses different tokenizer implementation which produces slightly different token boundaries — requires alignment
Auth noise: internal request IDs are present in headers for some integrations; Security wants stricter masking rules before snapshots are persisted
